\caption{Active Learning Algorithm for Trees with Homogeneous Edges}
	\textbf{Input:}  The number of nodes $p$, the number of vector samples $n$\\
	\textbf{Output:} Estimated tree structure $\hat{\mathcal{T}}_{{\rm active}}(n)$ \\
	\textbf{Procedure:}
	\begin{algorithmic}[1]\label{algo:alathe}
		\STATE \# Global Learning Phase\\
		\STATE Initialize $i=1$, $\hat{\alpha}_{0}=0$, $\hat{\alpha}_{1}=0.8$.\\
		\WHILE{$\hat{\alpha}_{i}>\hat{\alpha}_{i-1}$}
			\STATE Acquire $\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor-\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i-1}n\rfloor$ vector samples of all the nodes.\\
			\STATE Learn the \ac{cl} tree $\hat{\mathcal{T}}_{\rm{SCL}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)$ as in Eqn.~\eqref{eq:clvariant}.\\
			\STATE Calculate $\hat{\rho}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)$ as in Eqn.~\eqref{eq:rhohat}.\\
			\STATE Set $\hat{\alpha}_{i+1}$ according to $\hat{\rho}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)$ and Table~\ref{table:alpha}.\\
			\STATE $i=i+1$.\\
		\ENDWHILE
		\STATE Set $\hat{\alpha}=\hat{\alpha}_{i-1}$. \\
		\STATE \# Local Refinement Phase\\
		\STATE Set $\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{V}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}=\emptyset$ and $\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{E}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}=\emptyset$.\\
		\FOR {All node triples $(i,j,k)$ where $\{i,j\},\{j,k\}\in \mathcal{E}\big(\hat{\mathcal{T}}_{\rm{SCL}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)\big)$ }
			\IF {$\mathcal{C}_{ijk}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)$  (defined in Eqn.~\eqref{eq:confevent}) does not hold}
				\STATE Add $\{i,j\},\{j,k\}$ to $\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{E}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}$ and add nodes $i,j,k$ to $\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{V}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}$.
			\ENDIF
		\ENDFOR
		\STATE Acquire $\lfloor(1-\hat{\alpha})np/|\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{V}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}| \rfloor$  sub-vector samples corresponding only to the nodes in $\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{V}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}$.\\
		\STATE Implement the \ac{scl} algorithm to relearn the structure of connected components in the subgraph formed by $\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{V}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}$ and $\mathscr{C}_{\mathrm{E}}(\lfloor\hat{\alpha}_{i}n\rfloor)^{\complement}$ using all the sub-vector samples corresponding to each connected component.
		\STATE Replace every connected component with the relearnt structure.
		\STATE Return the derived $\hat{\mathcal{T}}_{{\rm active}}(n)$.
	\end{algorithmic}

We will use a proof by contraposition, i.e., we show that if tildep(hatalpha n)geq 26d, then N(C_E(hatalpha n)^complement,T(C_V(hatalpha n)^complement),2)geq 13. The induced graph T(C_V(hatalpha n)^complement) is not necessarily a connected graph, and we assume that it has k components: T_1, ldots, T_k. For each component, we show that N(E(T_i),T_i,2)geq frac|V(T_i)|2d. See Fig.~ for an illustration of this proof.
